identity.name: Parkland Bay
identity.notes: Parkland Bay is a gated master-planned HOA community in Parkland, Broward County, FL (33076) featuring luxury single-family homes centered on a 178-acre lake. Built primarily by Lennar and GL Homes between 2018 and 2023, the 550-home community offers 4+ bedrooms and 4+ bathrooms with an average of 3,347 sq ft. Homes are organized into five collections (Waterfront, Signature, Classic, Estates, and Executive) with Mediterranean-inspired architecture ranging from 2,254 sq ft to 6,600+ sq ft. Managed by Campbell Property Management (754-714-5710, ParklandBayPM@campbellproperty.com, 8535 Parkland Bay Drive), the community features a 16,000 sq ft clubhouse and extensive recreational amenities. Median sold price is $1,400,000 ($405/sq ft); 141 homes sold in the past 2 years. Annual property taxes average $15,061.

fees.note: Average monthly HOA fee per HorizonPalm Realty listing data. Range approximately $300-$700 depending on specific home collection and lot. Exact current fees, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments are not publicly detailed. Annual property taxes average $15,061 (separate from HOA). Full lawn maintenance included in some collections. Management: Campbell Property Management, 8535 Parkland Bay Drive, Parkland, FL 33076, 754-714-5710, ParklandBayPM@campbellproperty.com, parklandbayhoa.com. Office hours not publicly available. Rules, architectural guidelines, landscaping standards, parking rules, pet policies, rental restrictions, noise regulations, and trash collection rules not publicly available in searchable sources.

proximity.nearest_name: Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School (A+ rated, grades 9-12)

Private options near Parkland Bay include Mary Help of Christians Catholic School (Pre-K-8) and Kol Tikvah Jewish Day School (K-12); most Parkland Bay children start at Heron Heights, then Westglades Middle, then MSD High per neighborhood guides
The Shops at Parkland (shopping, dining, fitness, groceries, everyday conveniences)

Parkland's five business centers per City of Parkland: Waterways Shoppes (7501-7679 N State Road 7), Parkland Commons (7805-8095 University Dr), Parkland Town Center (6604-6682 Parkside Dr), Riverstone Shoppes (7251-7391 N State Road 7), Shoppes of Parkland (5901-7203 W Hillsboro Blvd - closest to Parkland Bay, just south off Hillsboro Rd)

Weston Branch Library, Broward County Library (4205 Bonaventure Blvd, Weston, FL) - no Broward County Library branch exists in Parkland per the official county location list; Weston Branch and Margate Catharine Young Branch (5810 Park Dr, Margate) are the nearest listed branches

West Boca Medical Center (Boca Raton, FL) and Broward Health Coral Springs (Coral Springs, FL) among 71 hospitals listed near Parkland, FL within 50 miles; exact nearest facility and distance not stated on the page read
Downtown Boca Raton (~18 miles) and Pompano Beach (~17 miles) per buyer guide; Parkland Bay averages ~$1.24M per the same source

Airports per BEX Realty: Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood (FLL) 21 miles, Palm Beach International (PBI) 27 miles, Miami International (MIA) 38 miles; private airports (FXE, BCT, PMP, HWO) all within 24 miles
